exercises: An origin that says the specification used to be there and is not any more. Absent, on the same reasoning as 404 and not a state of its own: FR-044's four states turn on what is known about the specification now, and `withdrawn` and `never published` leave the system knowing the same thing. Committed as a second absent case so that a classifier which only recognised 404 would be caught rather than passing on the single status somebody thought of.
